grading-game

A photo color-grading game for photographers. Pick a flat RAW or scan, grade it in your favorite software (Lightroom, Capture One, DarkTable…), then compete with other photographers in timed rounds with anonymous voting.

Edit on any device — Lightroom Mobile, Snapseed, VSCO, Polarr… download the source, develop your grade in your favorite app, then upload your JPEG. Works on phone, tablet and desktop alike.
